notes: Homepage: 'The Original Outfitter since 1897', 'Unfailing Goods', banner 'Free Shipping over $99'. Men's outerwear subnav: Waxed Jackets, Wool Jackets, Insulated Jackets, Jac-Shirts, Vests (https://www.filson.com/).

Customer care: free economy shipping on US orders over $99; returns within 30 days of delivery (Filson Credit free, refund to card has an $8 fee, in-store returns free); lifetime guarantee against defects in materials and manufacturing; repairs via repairs.filson.com with an $8 assessment fee (https://www.filson.com/pages/customer-care).

Shipping page: Canada standard $37 / expedited $51; 'Filson does not accept orders from' a list that includes the United Kingdom; Australia not named, only 'All Other locations' $69, so AU left out of ships_to (https://www.filson.com/pages/shipping).

About: founded 1897 to outfit prospectors for the Alaska Gold Rush; C.C. Filson's original store on Seattle's First Avenue; headquarters and flagship store in the Star Manufacturing building, SODO, Seattle; 'Skilled employees can be seen sewing our Unfailing Goods through the First Avenue windows'. No parent company named, copyright 'C.C. Filson Co'. Flagship store = us_stores true; the Our Stores locator did not render a list (https://www.filson.com/pages/about-us, https://www.filson.com/pages/our-stores).

Outerwear products.json size options: XS–3XL on most styles; M Long–2XL Long on 6 styles. 'Made in USA' appears in 14 of 189 outerwear listings' text (https://www.filson.com/collections/outerwear/products.json).

Best-sellers collection (23 items, none marked down) spans tees ($55) to the Denim Tacoma Jacket ($299) and Dryden Backpack ($279), so bags are a big line too; outerwear is the largest product type Filson sells (https://www.filson.com/collections/best-sellers).
Alaskan Guide Shirt $149: flannel brushed on both sides, center-back box pleat, dual flapped chest pockets; sizes XS–3XL with Long in M–2XL (https://www.filson.com/collections/long-sleeve-shirts).
